guard/30123.htm.text: Guard Vesa: If you cross Death Pass in the north, you can get to Oren. I am originally from there, but because of the war with Elmore, they are severely restricting passage for the common people. I worry about whether my family is safe.

links.text: View the information about the lord and the tax rate of the manor.

guard/30123-1.htm.text: Guard Vesa: I have never been to the Corridor of Death. I heard it is a long and dangerous road, because of the monsters that come out from the Dragon Valley. If you want to know about the Corridor of Death, you should ask my partner, Zerome . He recently returned from making a patrol of that place.

guard/30123-2.htm.text: Guard Vesa: The region of Oren is north of Giran. I once had a chance to meet their guards, and they seem to have a very strict military discipline. Isn't it really ironic that the Ivory Tower, the traditional school of magic, is there?

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30123-01.htm.text: Vesa: What is it? Someone suspicious? Well, I haven't seen anyone like that. Hey! Zerome, I have something to ask you... Go ahead and ask Zerome.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30123-02.htm.text: Vesa: What is it? A suspicious person? Well, I haven't seen anyone like that... Wait! The person you're describing went into town not long ago. It hasn't been long, so you might still be able to find him in the town.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30123-03.htm.text: Vesa: Hey, we meet again. Did you find that person you were looking for? Well, good luck...

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
